summary: NewAmsterdam Pharma filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing that the European Commission granted marketing authorization for Ubeslo (obicetrapib 10 mg monotherapy) and Evlarco (obicetrapib 10 mg plus ezetimibe 10 mg fixed-dose combination) for primary hypercholesterolaemia and mixed dyslipidaemia across all EU member states plus Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway. This is the first worldwide regulatory approval of obicetrapib under the Menarini licensing agreement. Menarini holds exclusive European commercialization rights; NewAmsterdam receives tiered low-double-digit to mid-twenties royalties plus up to €833 million in milestones, with mid-teens millions of euros triggered. This is an ordinary product-approval current report, not a special situation.
